title: Operating an OT-2 for COVID-19 Testing
author: Max Marrone
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bejejcje

steps.title: Verify Robot Connection
steps.instruction: Ensure the OT-2 is connected to the Opentrons App.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the Robots tab and toggle the robot's lights on and off to test the connection.

steps.title: Verify Protocol Upload
steps.instruction: Confirm the correct protocol is loaded for the run.

substeps.instruction: Go to the Run tab and double-check the protocol name at the top of the screen.

steps.title: Start the Protocol
steps.instruction: Initiate the run via the Opentrons App.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Start run' exactly once to allow the OT-2 to home its motors and begin the protocol.

steps.title: Abort Protocol (If Necessary)
steps.instruction: Follow these emergency steps if the protocol must be aborted.

substeps.instruction: Shut down the OT-2 using the power switch on the back left side.
Turn the OT-2 back on and wait a few minutes for the pipettes to rise.
Manually remove any tips attached to the pipettes to prevent liquid aspiration during homing.
Reconnect to the OT-2 in the Opentrons App.
Click the Home button to move the gantry and allow access to the deck labware.
